title: Bootstrap pnpm monorepo + shared TS config
description:
Foundation work for the entire repo.
- Create root `package.json` (private), `pnpm-workspace.yaml` listing `apps/*` and `packages/*`.
- Add `tsconfig.base.json` with strict mode, `module: NodeNext`, ESM, `target: ES2022`.
- Add `.gitignore`, `.npmrc` (`auto-install-peers=true`).
- Root script `dev`: `pnpm -r --parallel run dev`.
- Acceptance: `pnpm install` at the root succeeds with empty workspaces; `pnpm -r ls` lists the workspace roots even if empty.

title: packages/shared — types + ROLE_CAPS
description:
Create the shared TypeScript package consumed by every other workspace.
- `packages/shared/package.json` (`@qnc/shared`, `"main": "./dist/index.js"`, `"types": "./dist/index.d.ts"`, build script `tsc -p tsconfig.json`).
- Implement `src/types.ts` exporting `Chain`, `Role`, `Endpoint`, `User`, `NodeHealth`, `RpcLogEntry`, `MetricSnapshot`, `UsageSummary`, `InvoiceLine` per architecture doc.
- Implement `src/roles.ts` with the full `ROLE_CAPS` map for admin/developer/billing/viewer.
- `src/index.ts` re-exports everything.
- Vitest test asserting every Role has nav + 5 capability flags and that admin sees all 8 nav items, billing sees ≤2.
- Acceptance: `pnpm --filter @qnc/shared build` produces `dist/`.

title: apps/node-eth + apps/node-avax — EVM mock node
description:
Build a single reusable EVM JSON-RPC handler and instantiate two Fastify servers.
- Create `apps/node-eth` (port 8501, chain `'eth'`, chainId `0x1`, tick 12 000 ms) and `apps/node-avax` (port 8502, chain `'avax'`, chainId `0xa86a`, tick 2 000 ms). Mostly identical, parameterised by config.
- Each: Fastify 5, ESM, `tsx watch src/server.ts` dev script.
- `GET /` → `{ chain, ticker, blockHeight, uptimeS }`.
- `POST /` accepts JSON-RPC; dispatcher implements all 17 methods listed in the brief; unsupported → error `-32601`.
- Use `crypto.randomBytes` for hex addresses/hashes/blobs.
- Add CORS headers to every response.
- Vitest: POST `eth_blockNumber` returns `0x…`; unknown method returns `-32601`; tick increments after `vi.advanceTimersByTime(13000)`.
- Acceptance: `curl -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"method":"eth_blockNumber","params":[]}' http://localhost:8501` returns hex; height grows over ~15 s.

title: apps/node-btc — Bitcoin mock node
description:
Mirror Phase-1 work for BTC.
- Port 8503, chain `'btc'`, ticker `'BTC'`, tick 600 000 ms.
- `GET /` returns the same shape.
- `POST /` JSON-RPC handler covering: `getblockcount`, `getbestblockhash`, `getblockchaininfo`, `getnetworkinfo`, `getmempoolinfo`, `getblockhash`, `getblock`, `getrawtransaction`, `getbalance`, `estimatesmartfee`, `getmininginfo`, `getpeerinfo`. Returns realistic-shaped objects (chain string `'main'`, verificationprogress ~ 0.999..., bytes/utxo numbers, mediantime, version `260000`, etc.).
- Unknown methods → `-32601`. CORS headers.
- Vitest: `getblockcount` returns a positive integer; `getblockchaininfo` returns an object containing `chain`, `blocks`, `bestblockhash`.
- Acceptance: `curl -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"method":"getblockcount","params":[]}' http://localhost:8503` returns a number; `pnpm --filter "./apps/node-*" --parallel run dev` starts all three nodes.

title: apps/api — Fastify scaffolding + in-memory store + seed data
description:
Stand up the wrapper API process.
- `apps/api` Fastify 5 + `@fastify/cors` + `pino-pretty`, port 4000, ESM, `tsx watch src/server.ts`.
- `store.ts`: arrays for `endpoints`, `rpcLog` (circular helper `pushLog()` slicing to 2000), frozen `users` (4, one per role) and frozen `invoices` (6).
- Seed three endpoints with `nanoid`: `eth-mainnet-prod` / `avax-cchain-prod` / `btc-mainnet-prod`, each `{ id, name, chain, createdAt, token: 'qnc_' + nanoid(20) }`.
- Implement routes: `GET /health`, `GET /v1/users`, `GET /v1/endpoints`, `POST /v1/endpoints`, `DELETE /v1/endpoints/:id`, `GET /v1/billing/invoices`.
- Vitest using `fastify.inject()` for each route.
- Acceptance: `curl http://localhost:4000/health` → `{ ok:true }`; `curl http://localhost:4000/v1/endpoints` returns the 3 seeded items.

title: apps/api — RPC proxy + metrics + logs + usage + nodes
description:
Add the dynamic API routes that depend on the mock nodes from T03/T04.
- `proxy.ts`: `NODE_URL` map, `forward(endpoint, body)` using `fetch`, measures duration with `performance.now()`, records to `rpcLog` (`{ ts, endpointId, chain, method, durationMs, ok, error? }`).
- `POST /v1/rpc/:endpointId` route uses proxy; surfaces JSON-RPC errors as ok-but-with-error.
- `metrics.ts`: percentile helper + `computeMetrics(endpointId, windowMs)`; route `GET /v1/metrics?endpointId&windowMs`.
- `GET /v1/logs?endpointId&limit` — reverse-chronological slice of `rpcLog`.
- `GET /v1/usage` — totals + monthToDate (Discovery plan: $49 base + $25/M overage on top of 80 M included).
- `GET /v1/nodes` — `Promise.all` GET each mock node `/` with timeout, build `NodeHealth[]` (status `'healthy'` if reachable, latency from fetch timing, peers/disk/syncProgress/version generated deterministically).
- Vitest: percentile maths on fixed array; mocked `fetch` for nodes route.
- Acceptance: `curl http://localhost:4000/v1/nodes` returns 3 chains with live block heights; one POST to `/v1/rpc/:id` is reflected in `/v1/metrics` within 1 s.

title: apps/web — Vite + React 18 bootstrap + theme + RoleContext
description:
Stand up the frontend skeleton.
- `apps/web` with `vite`, `@vitejs/plugin-react`, React 18, TypeScript, plain CSS (NO Tailwind).
- `vite.config.ts`: port 5180, `strictPort: true`, proxy `/api` → `http://127.0.0.1:4000`.
- `styles/global.css` + `styles/tokens.css` per architecture (dark slate, role accents, chain colours, mono var).
- `context/RoleContext.tsx`: hydrates from `localStorage['qnc.role']`, default `'admin'`; sets `data-role` attribute on `<body>` so accents retint.
- `lib/api.ts` typed wrappers for every API route, importing types from `@qnc/shared`.
- `lib/usePoll.ts` generic polling hook.
- React Router v6 with the 8 page routes (placeholders ok).
- `<Header/>` with `<RoleSwitcher/>` (lists 4 mock users from `/v1/users`, persists choice).
- `<Sidebar/>` renders only `ROLE_CAPS[role].nav`.
- Vitest + React Testing Library: switching role updates `localStorage` and hides nav items.
- Acceptance: `pnpm --filter @qnc/web dev` → `http://localhost:5180` loads, role dropdown switches sidebar items.

title: Pages — Overview, Nodes, Metrics (data-heavy, polling)
description:
Implement the three live-data pages.
- **Overview** (`pages/Overview.tsx`): 4 stat cards (total requests, avg latency, error rate, healthy chains) computed from `/v1/usage` + `/v1/metrics` + `/v1/nodes`. Node fleet row of 3 compact `<NodeCard/>`. `<LiveLogTable/>` from `/v1/logs?limit=50`. Polls 4 s.
- **Nodes** (`pages/Nodes.tsx`): one large `<NodeCard/>` per chain — big block number, peers, latency, disk, uptime, sync %, version text, sync progress bar. Polls 2.5 s.
- **Metrics** (`pages/Metrics.tsx`): endpoint dropdown + window pills 1m / 5m / 1h / 24h. 5 stat cards (requests, errors, p50, p95, p99). `<BarChart/>` of `byMethod[]` (plain SVG, no chart lib). Polls 3 s.
- Components extracted: `StatCard`, `NodeCard`, `BarChart`, `LiveLogTable`, `ProgressBar`, `ChainBadge`.
- Vitest: `<StatCard/>` renders label/value; `<BarChart/>` renders one `<rect>` per method.
- Acceptance: Nodes page block number ticks up live; Metrics shows non-zero counts after a few RPC calls.

title: Pages — Endpoints + Playground (capability gates + RPC client)
description:
Implement the two interactive admin/developer pages.
- **Endpoints** (`pages/Endpoints.tsx`): table of `<ChainBadge/>`, name, monospaced id, copyable proxy URL `/api/v1/rpc/<id>` via `<CopyButton/>` + `<ToastHost/>`, created date. Render `<CreateEndpointForm/>` only when `ROLE_CAPS[role].canCreateEndpoint`. Render delete button per row only when `canDeleteEndpoint`.
- **Playground** (`pages/Playground.tsx`): endpoint dropdown, method `<input>`, params `<textarea>` (JSON array, parsed safely), `Send` button → `POST /api/v1/rpc/:id`. Pretty-printed response panel with monospaced JSON + observed latency. Sample method chips: EVM-list when chain ∈ {eth, avax} (`eth_blockNumber`, `eth_chainId`, `eth_getBalance`, `eth_gasPrice`, `eth_feeHistory`); BTC-list otherwise (`getblockcount`, `getblockchaininfo`, `getnetworkinfo`, `estimatesmartfee`).
- Components: `CopyButton`, `Toast`, `ChainBadge`, `RolePill` reused from T08.
- Vitest: viewer role sees no Create / Delete / Playground submit; clicking a sample chip fills the inputs.
- Acceptance: Playground `eth_blockNumber` against eth-mainnet-prod returns hex matching `curl http://localhost:8501 …` within a tick; Endpoints copy button surfaces a toast.

title: Pages — Users, Billing, Settings (role-only views)
description:
Round out the navigation.
- **Users** (admin-only nav): table from `/v1/users` with avatar (initials circle), name, email, `<RolePill/>`, capabilities blurb derived from `ROLE_CAPS[user.role]`.
- **Billing**: month-to-date stat card (requests / 80M included) + `<ProgressBar/>` + estimated cost ($49 + $25/M overage) + invoice table from `/v1/billing/invoices`.
- **Settings** (admin-only nav): read-only workspace facts (workspace name `'QNC Demo'`, plan `'Discovery'`, region `'us-east-1'`, build sha = git short hash if available else `'dev'`).
- Hide /users, /billing, /settings in routes when not in `ROLE_CAPS[role].nav` (404 fallback).
- Vitest: switching to `billing` role hides Users + Settings + Endpoints + RPC + Nodes from the sidebar; switching back to `admin` restores all 8.
- Acceptance: Acceptance criterion #1 from the brief — switching to Billing hides Endpoints / RPC / Nodes / Users; switching back to Admin restores them.

title: Wizard's-choice polish — latency sparkline + sidebar healthy-chain pulse
description:
Implement two spec'd wizard's-choice features that no current task covers.
- **Latency sparkline (spec wizard's-choice #2)**: render a tiny inline SVG sparkline of the last 30 `durationMs` values per endpoint on the Overview page. Either group rows of `<LiveLogTable/>` by `endpointId` and add a sparkline cell, or render a small per-endpoint sparkline strip above the log table — pick whichever reads cleanly. Plain SVG `<polyline>` ~80×20 px, accent-coloured, no chart lib.
- **Healthy-chain pulse dot (spec wizard's-choice #4)**: in `<Sidebar/>`, when the `nodes` nav item is rendered, add a coloured pulse dot beside the label driven by polled `/v1/nodes`: green if all 3 statuses are `'healthy'`, amber if any are `'lagging'`, red if any are `'down'`. Use `usePoll` at 5 s. Add a CSS `@keyframes pulse` animation in `tokens.css` / `global.css` and class `nav-dot nav-dot--green|amber|red`.
- Vitest: sparkline renders an `<svg>` with a `<polyline>` whose `points` attribute has 30 comma-separated pairs given a 30-entry log fixture; sidebar pulse dot has class `nav-dot--green` when all nodes healthy and `nav-dot--red` when one is `'down'` (mock the `/v1/nodes` fetch).
- Acceptance: Overview live-log shows a moving sparkline as RPC traffic flows; switching a mock node off in code turns the sidebar Nodes dot red within one poll.

title: Accessibility polish pass (focus rings + ARIA + role-pill contrast)
description:
Address the spec's a11y NFRs that no other task explicitly covers.
- **Keyboard-focus rings**: add a global `:focus-visible` outline rule in `styles/global.css` (e.g. `2px solid var(--accent)` with 2px offset) that applies to `button`, `a`, `[role="button"]`, `input`, `select`, `textarea`, and the Role Switcher trigger. Inline-styled buttons in `Endpoints.tsx`, `Playground.tsx`, `RoleSwitcher.tsx`, `CopyButton.tsx` should not strip the outline.
- **ARIA on icon-only buttons**: audit `<CopyButton/>`, the sidebar pulse dot (T12), the sample chips, and any close/delete glyphs — every icon-only control must have an `aria-label`. Where a label is decorative, mark it `aria-hidden="true"`.
- **Role-pill WCAG AA contrast on `#161c28`**: verify each `<RolePill/>` foreground vs the panel background hits ≥4.5:1. Adjust the four role token values in `tokens.css` (or add `--accent-{role}-text` overrides) where they fall short — the current `--accent-billing #f59e3a` and `--accent-viewer #8a93a6` are likely sub-AA on `#161c28`.
- **Semantic landmarks sanity check**: confirm `<App/>` has exactly one `<main>`, `<Sidebar/>` is a `<nav aria-label="primary">` (already), `<Header/>` is a `<header>` (already). Wrap `<ToastHost/>` output in `role="status" aria-live="polite"`.
- Vitest: render `<RolePill role="billing"/>` and assert computed colour pair passes a small inline contrast helper (luminance maths inline, no extra deps); render `<CopyButton/>` and assert it has a non-empty `aria-label`.
- Acceptance: tab through every page and every interactive control shows a visible focus ring; no icon-only button reports a missing-name violation in a manual axe-core spot check; all four role pills are legible on a `#161c28` swatch.

title: Root `pnpm dev` orchestration + readme + smoke acceptance
description:
Final wiring so a single command brings up all 5 services.
- Confirm root `package.json` `"dev": "pnpm -r --parallel run dev"` and that every workspace defines `dev`.
- Add a top-level README with run instructions and a checklist of the brief's acceptance bullets (do not duplicate the spec).
- Add `pnpm dev` smoke check using `wait-on` (or a small script) that verifies all 5 ports respond before resolving.
- Manually run through the 5 acceptance bullets:
  1. `pnpm dev` brings up all 5 services in parallel.
  2. Role switching hides/shows expected sidebar items.
  3. Playground `eth_blockNumber` matches mock-node curl within a tick.
  4. Metrics shows non-zero counts after a few calls.
  5. Nodes page shows live block heights ticking up.
- Acceptance: every bullet passes; `pnpm -r test` is green.

title: User-story end-to-end coverage + final QC sweep
description:
Buffer task for after T11. T11 only walks the 5 brief-level acceptance bullets; the spec's **User Stories** section lists 7 stories, two of which (#3 Playground latency-counted-in-metrics-within-1s, #5 billing-role narrow sidebar exact contents, #7 metrics window pills + p50/p95/p99 + by-method bar) deserve explicit Vitest coverage that exercises the full data path, not just isolated components.

Work:
- Add (or extend) one Vitest per uncovered user story under `apps/web/src/__tests__/userStories/` (or co-located):
  - **US-2 admin create endpoint → proxy URL appears**: render `<Endpoints/>` as admin, fill the create form, mock `POST /v1/endpoints`, assert the new row + a copy button with value `/api/v1/rpc/<new-id>` appear.
  - **US-3 playground call counted in metrics within 1 s**: integration-style test against the real `apps/api` via `buildApi()` + a stub mock-node fetch, POST `/v1/rpc/:id` then immediately `GET /v1/metrics?windowMs=60000` and assert `requestCount === 1` (the `1 s` SLO is the spec's claim; the test just asserts the count is reflected before the next tick).
  - **US-5 billing-role sidebar exact set**: assert sidebar contains exactly `Overview` + `Billing` and DOES NOT contain `Endpoints`, `RPC Playground`, `Nodes`, `Users`, `Settings`. Existing `Sidebar.routerAcceptance.test.tsx` may already partially cover; extend if so.
  - **US-7 metrics window pills**: render `<Metrics/>` with a mocked `/v1/metrics` endpoint that returns different shapes per `windowMs`, click each of `1m / 5m / 1h / 24h`, assert the request to the API used the matching `windowMs` query param and the displayed counts updated.
- Spot-check final polish:
  - Confirm every `package.json` has `type: "module"` and the root `tsconfig.base.json` has `strict: true` (NFR DX).
  - Grep for stray `console.log` in `apps/*/src/**` (excluding intentional `[api] listening on…` boot log + tests) and remove.
  - Run `pnpm -r test` and `pnpm -r build` (where defined) and confirm both green; if `build` fails on `apps/web` or others lacking it, that's fine — only fail on packages that declare it.
- Acceptance: 4 new/extended tests green; `pnpm -r test` green; no leftover `console.log` in production paths; PM-notes updated with a one-line summary.

title: Premium UI polish + dedicated role-switch screen — micro-interactions, depth, motion across pages, and a login-style role picker
description:
Goal: take the dashboard from functional-but-flat to a Linear / Vercel /
Stripe-quality dark UI, AND replace the top-right role dropdown with a proper
full-screen role picker that feels like a polished login. No logic / route /
ROLE_CAPS / API changes — only visual polish, motion, and the role-pick
restructuring. Plain CSS, framer-motion if installed (else add it). No
Tailwind / shadcn / MUI.

# Visual language (across the app)
- Layered depth: introduce bg → bg-2 → panel → panel-elevated tones instead
  of two flat fills. Add a 1-2% noise texture on body background.
- Cards: 1px hairline border + faint top highlight (box-shadow inset 0 1px 0)
  to fake elevation. Hover lifts 1-2px / 200ms ease, shadow tightens.
- Type: tight letter-spacing (-0.01em) on h1/h2, tabular-nums on metric
  numbers, true monospace stack for IDs/hashes/code.
- One accent per role (blue/green/amber/grey) with WCAG-safe text-on-bg.
- Status pills (lifecycle/role/chain) = 1px tinted border + tinted bg +
  tabular type, never just colored text.

# Micro-interactions
- Buttons: 150ms transform on press, 200ms color/border on hover, focus
  ring via box-shadow (no outline jumps), disabled = 40% opacity.
- Inputs: focus brings a 1px gradient border via box-shadow, no layout
  shift.
- Tables: row hover bg, sticky headers, monospace columns aligned with
  tabular-nums, "copy" icon affordance reveals on row hover; copy success
  flashes the icon green for 1s.
- Loading: skeleton placeholders pulsing on a 1.4s ease-in-out (replace
  bare "loading…" text everywhere).
- Empty states: every page that can be empty (Endpoints, Metrics, Logs)
  gets a small icon + one-line copy.

# Motion
- AnimatePresence + layout transitions on every list (Endpoints, Logs, Task
  chips). Children stagger at 30ms.
- Page changes: 180ms cross-fade + 4px y-shift on the content container;
  header static.
- Number changes (request count, latency, block height) animate via a ~400ms
  tween from old to new.
- Sidebar nav active indicator: a single shared layoutId pill that slides
  between items.
- Sparkline / mini-charts: draw-in animation on first render
  (stroke-dashoffset).
- Reduced-motion media query disables every animation (0.001s fallback).

# Specific page upgrades
- Overview: stat cards get a tiny sparkline behind the number; "live" pulse
  dot next to the request log when traffic is flowing.
- Nodes: each chain card gets a faint chain-tint gradient (5% accent →
  transparent) and a subtle parallax tilt on hover.
- RPC Playground: response panel renders syntax-highlighted JSON via a
  small inline tokenizer (no heavy lib). Sample-method chips show a
  slide-up tooltip.
- Metrics: window pills use shared layoutId; bar chart bars animate from 0.
- Endpoints: rows fade-in staggered; "copy URL" turns green for 1s; replace
  inline button with a row-level kebab menu (delete only for now).

# /switch — dedicated role picker
- Add a /switch route. App boot: if localStorage has no qn:role → redirect
  to /switch. Otherwise hydrate and render dashboard.
- Picking a role persists to localStorage and navigates to /.
- DELETE the existing RoleSwitcher dropdown component, its tests, its
  styles. No references remain.
- /switch layout: full-bleed dark page, brand logo + "QuickNode Clone"
  wordmark centered top, subtitle "Pick a role to enter the console."
- 4 role cards (admin/developer/billing/viewer) using the 4 mock users
  from /v1/users:
  - Avatar (large), display name, role title, ROLE_CAPS[role].blurb,
    accent stripe in the role's tint.
  - Hover: lifts 4px, shadow softens, accent brightens.
  - Keyboard navigable; Enter selects; pressed: 200ms scale-down 0.97
    before navigation.
  - Card matching the previously-stored role gets an outer accent glow
    so user sees "you were ${admin}".
- 4 cards in a row at ≥900px, 2x2 at 600-900, 1col below 600.
- Cards animate in with framer-motion stagger (30ms, spring 220/22).
- Background: 2-3 floating accent gradients, very low opac

title: Post-U1 a11y re-audit + acceptance smoke re-walk + README touch-up
description:
Buffer task for after U1. U1 introduces a large surface of new components, animations, and a brand-new `/switch` route — none of which existed when T13 (a11y NFR pass) and T11 (5-bullet smoke) were closed. Without an explicit re-audit, the spec's a11y / perf / DX NFRs can silently regress.

Work:
- **`/switch` a11y audit** (only if it exists post-U1):
  - Each role card is keyboard-reachable (Tab moves between them, Enter activates) and has an accessible name combining display name + role title.
  - Cards use a real interactive element (`<button>` or `role="button" tabindex=0`) — not a bare `<div>` with a click handler.
  - The `:focus-visible` ring rule from T13 is visible on the cards (don't let card hover styles override it).
  - Vitest: render `<SwitchPage/>` with mocked `/v1/users`, assert each card has a non-empty `aria-label` (or visible accessible name) and that pressing Enter on the focused card calls the navigate stub with `'/'` and writes `qnc.role`.
- **Reduced-motion compliance**:
  - Confirm `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` block in `global.css` zeroes (or 0.001s) every transition / animation / framer-motion-driven motion. Add a Vitest that grep-asserts the rule's existence in the bundled CSS source.
- **New-component a11y sweep**:
  - Any new icon-only controls introduced by U1 (kebab menu in Endpoints rows, sample-method chip tooltip triggers, copy-icon affordance on table row hover) must have `aria-label`s — extend the existing `CopyButton.aria.test.tsx` pattern to cover the kebab + tooltip triggers.
  - JSON syntax tokenizer in Playground must not produce `<span>`s that break screen-reader text flow — assert `textContent` of the rendered tokenized JSON equals the original `JSON.stringify(value, null, 2)`.
- **Contrast re-check on new tinted backgrounds**:
  - Nodes chain-tinted gradient cards and `/switch` accent-stripe cards must keep body text ≥4.5:1 against the *effective* background (gradient top-left). Reuse `lib/contrast.ts` from T13 in a small helper test that checks two sample foreground/background pairs per chain.
- **T11 smoke re-walk**:
  - Re-execute the 5 acceptance bullets from T11 against the post-U1 build (script at `scripts/smoke.mjs` already exists from T11 — confirm it still passes; extend it with a 6th bullet that hits `http://localhost:5180/switch` and asserts a 200).
  - `pnpm -r test` must remain green; specifically, every test that referenced the deleted `RoleSwitcher` should be gone (not skipped, not commented out).
- **README touch-up**:
  - Add a short `## First run` paragraph documenting the `/switch` flow: "on first load with no `qnc.role` in localStorage, the app redirects to `/switch` for role selection".
  - No spec content duplication; just the flow + how to clear `localStorage.qnc.role` to re-trigger the picker.
- Acceptance: every NFR (a11y AA, reduced-motion, perf-poll-≤4s) still green post-U1; `pnpm -r test` green; smoke script green incl. `/switch`; README mentions the `/switch` boot flow; pm-notes appended with a one-line summary.

title: /switch a11y audit — semantic <button>, focus-visible ring, keyboard activation Vitest
description:
Audit the new `/switch` route created by U1 to ensure it meets the a11y NFRs from T13.

**Files to touch**
- `apps/web/src/pages/Switch.tsx` — verify semantic shape; tweak only if needed. Currently uses `<motion.button type="button">` with `aria-label={`Continue as ${ROLE_TITLE[role]}`}`. Extend the label to include the user's display name once `users` are loaded (e.g. `Continue as ${user.name}, ${ROLE_TITLE[role]}`); fall back to the role-title-only string when the user list is still loading.
- `apps/web/src/styles/global.css` (and/or `apps/web/src/styles/tokens.css`) — confirm the global `:focus-visible` ring still applies to `.role-card`. If the card's hover rule strips it, add a scoped `.role-card:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--card-accent), var(--shadow-md); outline: 2px solid var(--card-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }` (or equivalent that preserves accessibility against the accent stripe).
- `apps/web/src/pages/Switch.test.tsx` — extend the existing file (already mocks `/v1/users`).

**Expected behaviour**
- All 4 `[data-testid="role-card"]` elements are real `<button type="button">` (already true via `<motion.button>`).
- Each card exposes an accessible name combining display name + role title once users have loaded; falls back to role title only when the user list is loading.
- Pressing **Tab** moves between the four cards in DOM order; pressing **Enter** or **Space** on the focused card writes `qnc.role` to `localStorage` and navigates to `/`.
- The `:focus-visible` ring is visible on the focused card (no `outline:none` without a replacement box-shadow).

**Acceptance criteria**
- New/extended Vitest assertions in `Switch.test.tsx` (using `vi.mock('react-router-dom', …)` to stub `useNavigate` with a `vi.fn()`):
  1. After `/v1/users` resolves, every `[data-testid="role-card"]` returns a non-empty `getAttribute('aria-label')` containing the role title AND (when user is loaded) the display name (e.g. matches `/Administrator/i` and the actual user name).
  2. Each card is `tagName === 'BUTTON'`.
  3. Focus the admin card and dispatch keyboard `Enter` — assert `localStorage.getItem('qnc.role') === 'admin'` AND the navigate mock was called with `'/'`.
  4. Same as (3) but for `Space` (` ` key).
- `pnpm --filter @qnc/web test` stays green.

**Out of scope**
- No layout / visual changes beyond the minimal a11y tweaks above.
- No changes to `RoleContext` or routing logic.
- No new framer-motion behaviour.

title: Reduced-motion CSS guarantee + new-component (Kebab/Tooltip/JSON-tokenizer) a11y sweep
description:
Lock in two a11y guarantees added by U1's new surface: motion reduction and screen-reader friendliness of icon-only / tokenized content.
